description: This file defines a utility enum 'SystemPresenceInfo' containing static methods to retrieve system presence information such as the last input time in seconds and the primary IPv4 address, using system frameworks like CoreGraphics and custom modules like OpenClawKit.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds since the last user input event, or nil if unavailable or invalid.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Retrieves the primary IPv4 address of the system using the NetworkInterfaces utility.
